# interfere_surface (Data Source)

Look up an existing surface without managing its lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "interfere_surface" "web" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  slug           = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Surface URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `anonymous_user_tracking` (Boolean) Whether anonymous-user telemetry is collected.
- `id` (String) Unique surface identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name of the surface.
- `type` (String) Application framework used by the surface.
